name: academic-orchestrator
description: 学术科研编排核心（通用学术 + 数学建模子轨）。提供可验证的多 Agent 编排骨架：9 阶段状态机、门禁体系（M1/D1/P1/P2/A1/T1/V1/B1/W1/A2/W2/A3）、迭代环（SEARCH→DECIDE）、审阅配对、后台并行派发与运行中纠正、以及运行时技能热插拔路由（按任务扫描本机已装 skill 自动匹配，不含名称白名单）。专项能力：图表/表格的文献对标核查（B1 门禁，检索同领域论文实际图表列名与数据项判定完备性）、去 AI 化、LaTeX 质检、模型库与调优、赛题拆解。学术界主体能力（论文写作/深度研究/同行评审/系统综述）由 academic-research-skills 提供，ARIS、nature-* 家族按需协作；本插件不重复打包第三方副本，改由 mm-skill-router 运行时发现。23 个 Skill + 21 个 Agent + 7 个命令。

description_i18n.en: Academic research orchestration core (general academic + math-modeling track). Provides a verifiable multi-agent orchestration skeleton: 9-stage state machine, gate system (M1/D1/P1/P2/A1/T1/V1/B1/W1/A2/W2/A3), iteration loop (SEARCH->DECIDE), review pairing, background parallel dispatch with live mid-task correction, and runtime skill hot-plug routing (scans locally installed skills per task; no name allowlist). Specialized: figure/table literature benchmarking (B1 gate: retrieves peer papers' actual figure/table columns and data fields to judge completeness), de-AI polishing, LaTeX QA, model library and tuning, problem decomposition. Academic body capabilities (paper writing / deep research / peer review / systematic review) are provided by academic-research-skills; ARIS and nature-* collaborate on demand. 25 skills / 21 agents / 7 commands.
